rate.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol and https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing opened 2026-09-29; Standard short-context. More than 272000 input tokens costs 2x input/cache and 1.5x output. Per-request audit stops launches above threshold.
rate.billing: list-price-equivalent; Codex ChatGPT subscription consumes quota, not API dollars

new_candidates.claim: The newly supported direct-source method parses completion definitions with global aliases enabled, allowing alias -g ret=XX to rewrite _rg's final return; whether the named example loses the promised completion outcome is unresolved.
new_candidates.evidence: FAQ.md and the cutoff PR announce direct sourcing. rg.zsh defines _rg without disabling aliases and ends it with the unquoted bare word in return ret, while the ordinary autoload -U route suppresses alias expansion. This supports the parsing difference and a changed definition, not a measured completion failure.
new_candidates.limits: Focused zsh execution was rejected by the tool's missing encoded command allowance. No actual Tab result under ret=XX was checked. The review demonstrates a changed function listing rather than lost matches, and the return occurs after _arguments, so a changed definition alone cannot settle whether delivery fails or merely has a minor defect.
new_candidates.relevance: Settles delivery for blind-b20a9e item 6 and whether it is a new functional problem or a minor defect in an otherwise delivered native-zsh use; it is not any listed GT-n1 through GT-n5 symptom.
new_candidates.would_settle: Run the exact global-alias case with initialized real zsh completion and compare first-Tab matches, diagnostics and status with autoload -U, then rule on the resulting delivery classification.

new_candidates.claim: The added dispatcher prevents ci/test-complete's deliberate _RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS source operation from emitting specs when the shell already defines compdef, causing the test helper to fail instead of comparing options.
new_candidates.evidence: The project's own ci/test-complete sources the absolute completion path under _RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 and rejects an empty captured list. At the base the unconditional _rg call reached its print-and-return list path. At the head, with compdef defined and an absolute sourced path rather than _rg as funcstack[1], the tail only calls compdef and never enters that list path. The packet explains that supporting the test's non-completion source call is intentional.
new_candidates.limits: No built rg is available, so the full CI script and its final diagnostic were not run. The attempted focused shell execution was also tool-rejected. Source establishes the dispatch and missing-list regression under the stated environment, but does not establish how often real developer or CI startup files define compdef.
new_candidates.relevance: Could admit an additional problem beyond GT-n1 through GT-n5 and settle blind-bc4382 item 8. It concerns the project's built list-args/test contract rather than ordinary completion registration or the need to add a new test.
new_candidates.would_settle: User admission of this deliberate test-use regression, or a saved ruling limiting that helper to shells without compdef. A later available built-rg run with a preloaded compdef can confirm the end-to-end failure without being required to infer the source-level empty output.
